title: Tasks from your API
subtitle: Upload your OpenAPI file and your policy. Heimdall builds a copy of your app, a pinned model drafts tasks that test the policy, and each task is checked against the app copy before you review it.
entry: Build tasks from your OpenAPI file and policy
readOnly: You can look, but only members can start drafts, approve rules and review tasks.

new.title: New draft
new.benchmarkHelp: A new benchmark, or one made here before for the same app.
new.appHelp: The name of your app's tools, as the agent sees them (for example shop).
new.pasteOrPick: Paste it here or pick a file.
new.invalidIds: Use lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_' for the benchmark and app ids.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model is pinned: every call goes through the gateway on your own model key, and the job stops at the cost cap.
model.maxUsdHelp: Leave empty for the default cap.

app.title: App copy
app.operations: {{count}} operations, kept as tools over seeded data: {{collections}}

rules.title: Policy rules
rules.description: The model lists the policy as numbered rules. Fix any that are wrong, then approve the list once. Tasks are drafted only from approved rules.
rules.confirm: Drafting the rules calls the pinned model once or a few times and costs money. Go ahead?

tasks.title: Draft tasks
tasks.description: The model writes starting data and a few conversations per rule. Each one runs against the app copy: the right calls must work, and an agent that does nothing, skips the key step or breaks the rule must fail its checks.
tasks.judged: Also grade what the agent tells the customer (needs a judge model in the benchmark)
tasks.confirm: Drafting tasks calls the pinned model once per rule and once for the data, and costs money. Go ahead?

write.title: Write into the benchmark
write.description: Tasks go in as pending review. Run the readiness checks on the benchmark next: they build the app copy and prove each task on a real worker.

review.title: Review
review.description: Accept a task to mark it reviewed, or reject it to take it out of the benchmark.

loadError: The draft could not be loaded
listError: The drafts could not be loaded
